title: What's New — GitHub Automatic Updates
summary: PulseGuard v0.5.2 moves the launcher updater to the official PulseGuard-Updates GitHub repository. This is the one-time manual bridge release; later published versions can install automatically when the launcher opens.

items.heading: GitHub-powered automatic updates
items.detail: The launcher now checks the official PULSEGUARDPC/PulseGuard-Updates manifest on GitHub before the main program starts, with no Vercel, Cloudflare, or paid hosting dependency.

items.heading: Updater window runs before PulseGuard
items.detail: Every normal launcher start opens the dedicated update window first. It checks for a newer release, downloads and verifies it when available, then finishes opening the installed PulseGuard version.

items.heading: Full release integrity verification
items.detail: Downloaded release ZIPs must match the exact published byte size and SHA-256 hash before installation. The package is staged and validated before any runtime files are replaced.

items.heading: Protected local data and rollback
items.detail: Data, Logs, Reports, Backups, and the local system profile stay on the customer PC. Runtime files are backed up outside the install folder before an automatic update is applied.

items.heading: What's New still appears after updates
items.detail: Release notes remain inside each verified PulseGuard release. After a newly installed version opens, PulseGuard shows that version’s changelog once and stores the acknowledgement locally.

items.heading: Version visible in the dashboard
items.detail: The installed version remains displayed directly beside PULSEGUARD PC in the main dashboard header.
